    Simultaneous commutators over division ring localizations of free algebras #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.simultaneous_commutators_of_division_localization {k D ι : Type u} [Field k] [DivisionRing D] [Algebra k D] (g : FreeAlgebra k ι →ₐ[k] D) {κ : Type u_1} {φ : κ → TwoTerm (FreeAlgebra k ι)} (loc : IsUniversalLocalization φ g.toRingHom) (b : ι → Module.End k D) :
    ∃ (T : Module.End k D), ∀ (i : ι) (x : D), (b i) x = T (g (FreeAlgebra.ι k i) * x) - g (FreeAlgebra.ι k i) * T x

    A division ring obtained by universally inverting projective maps over a free algebra solves the simultaneous commutator equations for its generators.
